cc:Work.dc:description: Pointwise confidence intervals for the fitted mean P(V): P_hat(V) +/- t_nu((1+coverage)/2) sqrt(J C J^T). Displayed as horizontal P intervals with pressure on x and volume on y. mBM3 propagates full 3x3 covariance including Pr cross terms. Pair-joint ellipse coverage and pointwise mean coverage are different probability statements. No residual variance term is added for future measurements: these are not prediction intervals or simultaneous curve bands. No V0, measured-volume, pressure-scale/coefficient or systematic uncertainty is added. No source-published covariance or one-/two-sigma convention is invented. Existing catalog, observations, refits, parity and recommendations are unchanged.

g.text: Fe₃C at 300 K — Original Sata + unchanged Li
Conditional diagnostic 68.3% / 95% regions: pair-joint F ellipses; pointwise t mean P(V) bands (horizontal). Not prediction limits.
V₀/Vᵣ = 149.456 Å³/cell; mBM3 bands include full Pᵣ covariance. Calibration/systematic/input errors excluded; catalog findings unchanged.
